labels.boundary_numerics: absolute tolerance1e-12 only for floating-point equality at the unchanged thresholds

interpretation.scope: Exploration-informed prospective predictions; metadata mtime is not independent timestamp attestation.
interpretation.numeric_predicates: Original P-A/P-B/P-C/P-D thresholds preserved; explicit null/inconclusive handling added.

interpretation.C1: Descriptive recovery; report M1-minus-M0 separately. Absolute thresholds do not require benefit.
interpretation.C2: Descriptive partial recovery; no claim about the necessity of thinking or residual causes.
interpretation.C3: No observed channel restoration under this masking intervention.

interpretation.undefined_rule: A required unavailable aggregate yields UNDEFINED; P-C not read without P-B HOLDS, except C3 when FAILS. M5 support below10 tasks in any seed prevents C1, while independently evaluable C2 remains readable.
limits: No dominant-cause, mediation, tolerated-orphaning, training-seed generality or external-generalization claim.
No conditional H1 training decision is made by this analyzer.

resource_context.legacy_training_seed_sensitive_flag: Historical replication mismatch only; execution memory environment and initialization are confounded.
resource_context.matched_contrast: Fresh M1-minus-M0 remains paired within the identical capped v043 generation.

method.scope: Conditional on this fixed familiar task population and one paired training seed; decoding seeds are not training replicates.
method.unit: paired whole-task cluster; retain the fixed three-seed vector for each sampled task in both arms

limitations: Known-holdout exploratory intervention prompted by prior observations; not independent heldout confirmation.
One paired training seed; three decoding seeds do not establish training-seed generality.
Semantic deduplication against training data is unverified.
Empty-thought/scaffold masking has prior art including ThinkPack; no method novelty claim.
No claim that history dropping is harmless or that effects are specific to small models.
Observed thought text is not direct evidence of internal reasoning; secondary mechanisms do not establish causal mediation.
Historical A0/A1 comparisons remain descriptive; historical A1 initialization is not reconstructed.
All paired results use the same v043 sandbox memory limits; earlier unguarded partial runs are excluded.
